entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It seems like it's already begun.

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: And now, it's time for your favorite[n]Shujin tradition:

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: Buuuuut, before that: we've decided to[n]change things up this year!

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: We've got a huge surprise for you all!

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: Members of the dance club, c'mon[n]down!

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: Now everybody, join in! Don't fall[n]behind the dance club, strut your[n]stuff!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Just standing around while everyone[n]dances is embarrassing!

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: And, now that you're all warmed up,[n]let's switch up the musiiiiic!

entries.speaker: Dance Club Member
entries.en: We've got a little favor to ask you...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: [lName]-senpai, I'll be back soon—[n]they've asked me to help them with[n]something.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Just wait here, and watch what happens!
